description:
FILED s473t4 (#1501 CHECK 1 round 1, 2026-09-13) from the companion census: t/op/coreamp.t is the third-biggest early-stopper outside re/ + uni/ (723 rows short; P 778/0 vs C 9/46).

MEASURED (PCL_SUITE_KEEP on tools/run-perl-suite.pl --jobs 1 op/coreamp.t): FIFTEEN top-level forms abort, each recovered.  Grouped by cause:

  6  the CORE:: sub family
       Undefined subroutine &core::bless called
       Undefined subroutine &core::connect called
       Undefined subroutine &core::evalbytes called
       Undefined subroutine &main::__FILE__ called
       Undefined subroutine &main::__LINE__ called
       Undefined subroutine &stribble::__PACKAGE__ called
  2  PCL: given/when (feature 'switch') is not supported (lines 378, 467)
       -- ALREADY a registered not-supported reason, do not re-probe
  3  invalid number of arguments: 1 / 1 / 0   (a runtime arity error in the
       emitted CL -- needs its own minimisation)
  2  Undefined subroutine &File::Spec::Functions called
       Undefined subroutine &File::Temp called
  1  Undefined subroutine &main::foo called
  1  "The value" (truncated recovery line)

THE FILE'S SUBJECT is exactly this: it tests that `&CORE::foo` is callable and that its prototype matches.  So the dominant family is not incidental -- PCL has no `CORE::` sub package at all, and `__FILE__`/`__LINE__`/`__PACKAGE__` are compile-time tokens in PCL with no `&`-callable sub behind them.

PROBE (perl 5.40.3):
    perl -e 'print &CORE::lc("AB"), "\n"'        -> ab
    perl -e 'print &CORE::bless({},"X"), "\n"'   -> X=HASH(0x...)
    perl -e 'print &CORE::length("abcd"), "\n"'  -> 4

SIZE: the rows behind the 15 forms are 723.  Not all of them are the CORE:: family -- the file interleaves `&CORE::` tests with `&my*` comparison subs -- so the first step is to split the 723 by aborting form (the recovery lines are in the .out artifact, keep it with PCL_SUITE_KEEP).

WHERE IT BELONGS: `CORE::` is the LANGUAGE, not a module (CLAUDE.md 9a's core-builtin exception), so a `CORE::` package whose subs are the runtime's `p-*` entries is the shape -- but it is a MECHANISM, not a filler: every named unary and list operator would need an `&`-callable form with the right prototype.  Scheduled as part of round t5b (docs/plan-post-s473.md Â§5.5), not fixed in t4.
subject: op/coreamp.t: `&CORE::NAME` / `\&CORE::NAME` subs are not addressable, and `&__FILE__`/`&__LINE__`/`&__PACKAGE__` are undefined subs -- 723 of the file's 778 rows sit behind 15 aborted forms
